author: Levananya2013
body:
Hello Avicus,
I used to be a hacker and i was caught for doing so but this was 1 year ago i did not appeal because i agreed i was a hacker. I was banned for a fly hack. I do not hack anymore and i really want to play on your server. If you could could please allow me and unban me from the server I would really appreciate,
Levananya2013

title: Appeal to get unbanned

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello, 

I have decided to appeal this ban. I am willing to give you a second chance. However, if you're caught hacking again, you will have no chance of being appealed. 

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
